before: A party's suggested content control value copied another person's struck words, with their format records, into the new value, which the editor alone never writes; after a fold the copied record was that person's, and their format joined the party's card. The organiser's words typed in a party's new table cell, and a footnote the organiser made in a party's new row or cell, had a settled record of their own that a fold does not keep, so a reader of the labels found them in the party's card only after a fold. A value in a block control went after the control's paragraph mark, where no paragraph holds it, so no copy showed it, and a reopened Word file's reject kept the new value record. A paste or any other direct edit of the organiser in a party's new row, cell or note kept a settled record of its own, and the words a change loaded from the engine's template (a paste, a control's value) named no typer. A party's suggested value in a control its own pending suggestion put in was a second suggestion, a w:ins of the same author inside the first.
after: A content control value inserts only the words the value shows, as the editor alone does. The organiser's words in a party's new cell are part of the cell, as in a new row, note or text box, and a direct footnote's reference goes where a direct picture or field goes, so its labels read the same live and after one and two folds. A block control's value goes in its paragraph, and its value record follows what it shows after a decision, as an inline control's does. Every direct edit's words and objects in a pending new row, cell, note or text box become that container's when the edit settles, and template words name the change that loaded them as their typer. A party's value in its own pending control extends that suggestion, as the editor alone writes one insertion.
reason: Change messages, the change log and its kinds keep their meaning, and the Yjs document format does not change. Applying a control value, a direct note or typing in a new cell gives other items, but every copy applies the change log with the same code version, so the copies agree. Checkpoints keep their format. Ordered rooms are not deployed yet, so no room needs a migration.
